descriptions.professional_classic: A timeless, clean layout perfect for corporate and business roles. Balanced sections with a traditional structure.

descriptions.creative_bold: Eye-catching layout with bold typography and colour accents. Great for creative professionals and designers.
descriptions.simple_clean: Straightforward and easy to read. Focuses on content over design. Works well for any industry.
descriptions.academic_research: Structured layout optimised for academic CVs with sections for publications, research, and teaching.
descriptions.technical_developer: Developer-friendly template with sections for projects, tech stack, and open-source contributions.
descriptions.executive_suite: Premium design tailored for senior executives and leadership roles. Highlights achievements and impact.
